explication: This repository is a suite of .NET libraries, not one application with a single end-to-end flow. Its users compose facilities for AI, ingestion, resilience, ASP.NET diagnostics, compliance reporting, and developer tooling. The clearest sampled runtime flow is file ingestion: a caller runs the pipeline, which reads files, applies document processors, and writes processed chunks; results and failures are yielded to the caller. Other branches reflect major README capabilities and the file tree. Wiring beyond the sampled excerpts is shown only where the README or source supports it.
